title: RNA Purification with Magnetic Beads
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the purification of RNA using magnetic beads. It can support up to 94 samples and can have a custom starting well position. The protocol is also optimized for tip conservation and reuses tips for various steps. Explanation of parameters below: - `Number of Samples`: The total number of samples per run. The maximum samples supported is 94 samples. This value is also used to determine additional wells needed when setting a `Starting Well` below. For example, if there are 3 samples and the starting well is C7, then the sample wells for all plates will be C7, D7, E7. - `Starting Well Name`: The well name samples should begin with for each 96 well plate in the protocol. - `P300 Single GEN2 Mount Position`: Specify which mount (left or right) to load the P300 single channel pipette. - `Thermocycler Hold Temperature (°C)`: The temperature the thermocycler will be set to and held for the entire protocol. - `Magnetic Module Engage Height (mm)`: The height the magnets should raise. - `Supernatant Removal Radius (X-dimension) (mm)`: The radius in the X-dimension of how far the pipette should move before aspirating supernatant. **Note: Only enter positive values. The protocol will automatically determine the side (+/-) based on the well/column.** - `Supernatant Removal Aspirate Flow Rate (uL/s)`: The aspiration flow rate at which the pipette will aspirate supernatant. - `Supernatant Removal Dispense Flow Rate (uL/s)`: The aspiration flow rate at which the pipette will dispense supernatant. ---

Pause: Shake Beads on External Shaker
Delay for 2 minutes for extracting beads

steps.title: Set Thermocycler to 4 °C
steps.instruction: Set the Thermocycler temperature to 4 °C and hold it for the entire protocol.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 30 µL of magnetic beads into each well of the purification plate, engage the magnetic module, wait 2 minutes for bead attraction, then aspirate the supernatant from the side of each well.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 30 µL beads to each well
Remove supernatant from side of well

steps.title: Dilute samples with RNase‑free water
steps.instruction: Open the Thermocycler lid, add RNase‑free water to each sample to dilute them, and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Combine samples with beads and binding buffer
steps.instruction: Disengage the magnetic module, transfer the diluted samples into the bead‑containing wells and mix, add RNA Binding Buffer (RBB) to each well, and mix again to allow binding.

steps.title: Shake bead mixture
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and place the plate on an external shaker to shake the bead mixture.

steps.title: Capture beads and remove supernatant (first wash)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module, wait 2 minutes for bead attraction, then remove the supernatant from the side of each well, and finally disengage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Wash beads with wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add Wash Buffer (WB) to each well, mix the beads with the buffer, engage the magnetic module, wait 2 minutes for bead extraction, and remove the wash buffer.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Delay 20 minutes to allow the beads to air‑dry, then disengage the magnetic module.

steps.title: First elution with RNase‑free water
steps.instruction: Add RNase‑free water to the beads for the first elution, incubate for 5 minutes on the magnet, engage the magnetic module, wait an additional 2 minutes, collect the eluate, and disengage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Transfer first eluate to cooled plate
steps.instruction: Set the Temperature Module to 4 °C, then transfer the first eluate into a cooled recipient plate placed on the temperature module.

steps.title: Second elution with RNase‑free water
steps.instruction: Add fresh RNase‑free water as a second elution buffer, mix the beads, incubate for 5 minutes, engage the magnetic module, delay 2 minutes for bead extraction, transfer the second eluate to the cooled plate, and disengage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Deactivate all modules
steps.instruction: Disengage any engaged magnetic or temperature modules and conclude the protocol.
